name: Tenhouin Kaname
source:
A second-year student majoring in literature.

He loves reading and visits the library every day but chairs break under his weight, which causes many problems.

He gained weight in high school, so no one at university knows how thin he used to be. Whether it's a lie or not, when he was in junior high and high school, he was famous for being an ikemen.

His first problem is that he doesn't realize that he's fat.

[Translated from [url=https://karakuren.wixsite.com/kimikawa/tenhou]official website[/url]]
